description:
Re-score every trace in a run under the current rules into a new run, so a rules change is compared, not overwritten.

What it does. Writes the verdicts into a NEW run; the source run is never modified. Traces already scored under the current ruleset are skipped, so a repeat call does no work. Local, no model call. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. To score a new execution (log_trace, then evaluate_output).

Returns. JSON: source_run, run, ruleset_hash, traces, evaluated, already_current, failed, passed, summary, rules_changed.

Errors. IRIS_INVALID_ARGUMENT (empty run id, or the target run holds verdicts); IRIS_UNKNOWN_TRACE (source run empty); IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR. Unscorable traces are listed in failed. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. compare_runs — compare the two runs after; evaluate_output — re-score one trace; get_traces — read a run.

into.description: Run id for the new verdicts; defaults to <run>+reeval-<ruleset hash>, stable across repeats

label.description: a name for the new run, shown in listings

run.description: the run to re-score — whatever you passed as `run` on log_trace
